title: Bounded cohomology turns power torsion into rational vanishing
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $C\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], viewed in the derived category of sheaves of modules over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $u,v\in\mathbf Z$ with $u\leq v$, and let $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$. If $H^d(C)=0$ for $d\notin[u,v]$ and $\varpi_E^N H^d(C)=0$ for every $d$, then $\varpi_E^{N(v-u+2)}\operatorname{id}_C=0$ in that derived category. Consequently the image of $C$ in $D^b_c(X,E)=D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] is zero.

proof.text: Put A = O_E, pi = uniformizer and r = pi^N. Use the canonical constant-section Linear A structure on the ambient derived category and the inherited full-subcategory structure from lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear. The proof uses only bilinearity of composition for this particular structure: no identification with a separately induced Linear structure on complexes or cohomology is needed. Choose a complex K and an isomorphism Q(K) ≅ C by essential surjectivity of the derived localization. Scalar endomorphisms commute with all morphisms by bilinearity, so their vanishing on cohomology transports across this isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 05RU (definition-unbounded-derived-category), with the scalar-linear localization theorem cited as lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category; module scalar calculation written here

proof.text: Put K_q = Q(tau_{≤q} K). The cohomology of K_q maps isomorphically to that of Q(K) in degrees d≤q, and vanishes in degrees d>q. Consequently K_{a-1} is both ≤a-1 and ≥a in the standard t-structure, so is zero. The same calculations and the assumed upper bound show K_b→Q(K) is an isomorphism on every cohomology object, hence an isomorphism. These truncations are ambient; no constructibility assertion is required.

source.place: Tag 0118 (section-truncations), canonical truncation cohomology; derived.tex Tag 05RU, inversion of quasi-isomorphisms

proof.text: Use the distinguished successive-truncation triangle K_{q-1}→K_q→S_q→K_{q-1}[1], with S_q the single object H^q(K) in degree q. The map H^q(K_q)→H^q(QK) is an isomorphism; naturality of the scalar endomorphism and cancellation show H^q(r id_{K_q})=0. The long exact cohomology sequence makes H^q(K_q)→H^q(S_q) epi, since H^{q+1}(K_{q-1})=0. Naturality and epi cancellation therefore give H^q(r id_{S_q})=0. Fullness of the single functor and its natural isomorphism with the identity after H^q imply that H^q detects zero morphisms between single objects, so r id_{S_q}=0. The generic fully faithful single-functor Mathlib instances apply at arbitrary degree (the degree-zero assertion recorded by lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful shifted to q). This avoids assuming that the chosen ambient scalar structure equals a separately induced structure.

source.place: Tag 08J5 (remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle), successive-truncation triangle with a single cohomology object

proof.text: Induct on n≥0 with K_{a-1+n}, proving r^n id=0. The base is the zero object K_{a-1}. In the successor q=a+n, the induction hypothesis kills r^n id_{K_{q-1}}. Bilinearity shows i_q ≫ (r^n id_{K_q})=0. Hom-out-of-triangle exactness factors r^n id_{K_q} as j_q ≫ f. Multiply by r: r f = (r id_{S_q}) ≫ f = 0 by step 3, so r^{n+1} id_{K_q}=0.

source.place: Tag 0149 (lemma-representable-homological), contravariant Hom exactness; the scalar factorization and finite induction are written here

proof.text: Set n=(b-a+1).toNat; since a≤b, a-1+n=b. Step 4 kills r^n id_{K_b}. Conjugate through K_b≅Q(K)≅C using bilinearity, and multiply once more by r. Since (b-a+2).toNat=n+1 and (pi^N)^k=pi^(N*k), obtain the stated ambient identity. The integral constructible inclusion is full and its scalar action is inherited, so the same identity holds in End(C) in that subcategory.

source.place: Tag 05RU, derived category; elementary scalar calculation and the full-subcategory definition cited here

proof.text: Let m=N*(b-a+2).toNat. The actual raw localized identity is 1 tensor id_C in Localization.Away(pi) tensor_A End(C). Put z=invSelf(pi)^m. The defining localization identity gives pi^m • z=1, including m=0. Tensor balancing gives 1 tensor id_C = (pi^m • z) tensor id_C = z tensor (pi^m • id_C)=0 by step 5. The zero-identity criterion then makes the localized image a zero object. No coefficient-field identification is needed.
